patch_description:
Building on symmetry-driven parameter sharing, this revision injects a compact mid-layer that increases expressivity without exploding parameter count. The new ANSATZ_SPEC:
- Layer 1: symmetry-shared RZ rotations for corners, edges, and center
- Layer 2: symmetry-shared mid-layer RY rotations (new mid-layer)
- Layer 3: ring entanglement with CRY around the outer perimeter (shared parameter)
- Layer 4: hub entanglement CRX from center to edges (shared parameter)
- Layer 5: ring CRZ phase entanglement around the outer ring (shared parameter)
- Layer 6: symmetry-shared post-entanglement RZ rotations

This design preserves the data-reuploading scheme and the same measurement structure while increasing expressivity and promoting better generalization through deliberate parameter sharing. It stays within (and slightly extends) the prior parameter budget, aiming to improve validation/test metrics and reduce train-test gaps.
